svg.title: Screw length gauge 0–120 mm
svg.desc: A linear under-head datum and millimetre scale for measuring screw length, not screw diameter.
svg.metadata: {"attribution":"Technology Commons teaching materials by Andrew Andrade and contributors","category":"jigs-gauges","description":"A linear under-head datum and millimetre scale for measuring screw length\u2014not screw diameter.","dimensional_tests":{"minor_division_mm":1,"scale_length_mm":120},"dimensions":{"height":70,"width":180},"editors":["Inkscape","Vectorpea"],"files":{"preview":"generated/previews/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-screw-length.svg","svg":"generated/svg/jigs-gauges/tc-jig-screw-length.svg"},"fit_type":"none","generator":{"name":"technology-commons-laser-generator","version":"0.1.0"},"id":"tc-jig-screw-length","kerf_assumptions":{"clearance_mm":0.15,"kerf_mm":0.15,"warning":"Starting values only; select from a physical calibration cut."},"license":"CC-BY-SA-4.0","material":{"measured_thickness_mm":6.0,"name":"Baltic birch plywood","nominal":"1/4 inch","warning":"Measure every sheet; nominal 1/4 inch plywood is not necessarily 6.35 mm."},"notes":"Seat the underside of the screw head on the vertical zero datum and read the tip against the engraved scale.","operations":["CUT","SCORE","ENGRAVE"],"parameters":{"measurement_axis":"under-head-to-tip","minor_division_mm":1,"scale_length_mm":120},"review_status":"unverified","sensitivity":"none","shop":"general","skill_level":"introductory","source_reference":"Original procedural geometry; no traced or copied commercial artwork.","subcategory":"screw-length","tags":["gauge","jig","length","screw","screw-length"],"title":"Screw length gauge 0\u2013120 mm","tool_family":"screw-length","trademark_status":"original-generic","units":"mm"}

g.text: SCREW LENGTH: UNDER HEAD TO TIP
